programmes.t: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programmes.d: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005).

programmes.t: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programmes.d: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37; pianist Maya Oganyan makes her solo debut with the orchestra.
